Retrieve RAG background context for a dataset's variables

Source: R/rag.R
sd_retrieve_context.Rd

For each variable in x, searches store (a connected ragnar RagnarStore, e.g. via ragnar::ragnar_store_connect(), built from your own reference material) using the variable's name and label as the query, and formats the retrieved chunks into a text block citing their source. Meant to be passed as the context argument to sd_build_prompt() / sd_build_roxygen_prompt(), or simply via the store argument of sd_document() / sd_generate_roxygen(), which call this automatically.

Usage

sd_retrieve_context(x, store = NULL, top_k = 2, max_chars = 600)

Arguments

x

An sd_data object (see sd_read()) or an already-computed sd_summary object (see sd_summarise()).

store

A connected ragnar RagnarStore (see ragnar::ragnar_store_connect() / ragnar::ragnar_store_create()), or NULL (the default) to skip retrieval entirely and return NULL – this is what lets store stay an optional argument throughout the rest of the package.

top_k

Number of chunks retrieved per variable.

max_chars

Truncates each retrieved chunk to this many characters before including it, so a handful of long reference entries don't dominate the prompt.

Value

A single character string formatted for inclusion in a prompt (one bullet per retrieved chunk, source in parentheses), or NULL if store is NULL or nothing was retrieved.

Details

RAG support in SurveyDokum is deliberately a thin, optional layer: this function only consumes a store you have already built with ragnar from whatever reference material you choose (survey methodology glossaries, controlled vocabularies, prior codebooks, house style guides, ...) – SurveyDokum does not build or ship one for you. See the "Using RAG with SurveyDokum" vignette for a worked-through recipe with ragnar.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
store <- ragnar::ragnar_store_connect("oma_rag_store.ragnar.duckdb")
aineisto <- sd_read("survey_data.csv")
tausta <- sd_retrieve_context(aineisto, store)
cat(tausta)

# Kaytossa sd_generate_roxygen()/sd_document() kautta:
sd_generate_roxygen(aineisto, "survey_data", store = store)
} # }
